goal: Produce a portrait suitable for the profile of executives at a listed company, featuring prominently on the main forum guest banner and as a side image in public media reports, conveying a stable and trustworthy demeanor.

subject.gender: American male corporate executive known to the public as the prototype of Tim Cook.
subject.appearance: Short and neat silver-gray hair, fair skin, no beard or very short whiskers, wearing thin-framed glasses or gentle without glasses is acceptable, natural fine lines at the corners of the eyes.
subject.outfit: Navy blue two-button suit, light blue shirt, plain tie or a minimalist style with one button open

expression.mood: Calm, trustworthy gentle smile, not exaggerated
expression.gaze: Looking directly at the camera, slightly tilted within 5°, eyes clear

composition.shot: 胸像，头顶至肩线下约一手掌
composition.framing: The character's facial midline is slightly towards the left 1/3 of the image, leaving enough breathing light gray negative space on the right side.

background.type: Medium gray gradient to light gray background with studio shooting feel, can be very slightly blurred to vertical light color stripes behind shoulders, suggesting building facade but not discernible
background.depth_of_field: Shallow depth of field, softening begins 10cm outside the ear.

lighting.key_light: Left front 45° large softbox, intensity dominates
lighting.fill_light: Weak white card fill light at the right front 1:4, preserving the transition between the eye socket and lower jaw
lighting.rim_light: No strong contour lines, or only 5% higher at the hairline.

style.rendering: 8K level portrait details, can distinguish pores and fabric texture
style.post_processing: Skin smoothing only compresses highlight points, retaining smile lines and texture.

must_keep: Eye focus is accurate, not drifting
No Apple or third-party badges and trademarks.
Realistic skin texture, no fake whiteness or greyness
avoid: Cybercolor lights and colored outline lights
Recognizable headquarters building logo in the background
